policy.fee_basis: Percent of retail selling price; assumption interpreting catalog retailer-margin term. Hardware/software via ComputerLand; services direct with zero fee. Service channel is a proposal.
policy.rounding: Nearest cent; adjacent-cent check minimizes the percentage gap. Nonnegative central contribution takes precedence.
policy.formula: For proxy B, cost C and fee f: P=sqrt(C*B/(1-f)); contribution/net=1-C/(P*(1-f)) equals proxy discount=1-P/B. If C/(1-f)>B use break-even. Without a proxy use C/((1-f)*0.75).
policy.profit_definition: Unit contribution, not net corporate profit. Excludes R&D, capital/depreciation, marketing/vouchers, software development, tax and finance. Costs include modeled logistics and service delivery.
policy.risk: Stress losses remain visible. Equality is calibrated to central costs and baseline fees; interactive fee/cost scenarios retain prices and may diverge.
policy.availability: No documented withdrawal dates: offering_end=null. Announced PRO products retain provisional prices, excluded from available-only filters. No 1979 June prices for December Aurelia+; no 1980 June prices for November Abacus/Pulse 3.
policy.benchmark_policy: Primary period advertisements; itemized baskets and judgment adjustments labeled estimates. No later IBM PC, 1982 networks or later warranty prices used retroactively. Observed mail-order prices are included as competitive pressure. No exact benchmark means no substantiated discount claim.
policy.bundle_policy: Base-system costs already include keyboard, display, OS and one-year support. 1981 Artemis includes NIC and Server edition automatically. BPI suite and developer registration already include their respective contents. Composite rows are alternative purchase units, not additive sales totals.
policy.service_scope: On-site support is a proposed capped eight-hour engagement with modeled travel, not unlimited annual repairs. Training prices assume eight learners; customer-site sold as class ×8 with travel extra. BPI/Pulse course durations remain model assumptions.
policy.baseline: Frozen original baselines retained only for audit and demand anchoring. The former 40% contribution-reduction policy is superseded; each rebuild uses current costs and unchanged dated proxies.
policy.scope: All priced offers and annual snapshots. Promotional course variants balance after full voucher provision; partner baskets remain component sums.
policy.course_variant: Balance contribution after full voucher redemption against the course proxy. Fundamentals credit remains 50% of tuition; other regular-course credit $150. Reserve redemption once in marketing.
policy.bundle_balance: Each offered bundle uses its own proxy and costs. Exact percentage matching can exceed separate component prices; both routes are disclosed, with no invented discount cap.
policy.independent_bpi: BPI Systems owns and supports its applications independently. BPI receipts belong to BPI; baskets combine suppliers and do not imply Logix revenue or ownership. Training, setup, support contracts, upgrade-credit redemptions and tax excluded; quote separately. No new discount applied.
policy.bpi_upgrade_credit: Eligible same-platform module net licence payments credited once toward complete suite, capped at suite price, with credited licences retired; no cash refund or training/setup credit. Redemption costs must be modelled if upgrades are forecast.
